scripts.infra:up: docker compose up -d --build --wait postgres minio && docker compose run --build --rm minio-init
scripts.build: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspaces
scripts.typecheck: npm run db:generate && npm run typecheck --workspaces
scripts.test: npm run test:container && npm run test --workspaces
scripts.storage:verify: npm run build --workspace backend && node scripts/verify-storage.mjs
scripts.uploads:cleanup: npm run db:generate && npm run build --workspace backend && npm run cleanup:uploads --workspace backend
